row.title: A return kit, packed twice
row.body: The inventory pairs a sealed supply with its ordinary spare, but leaves no name beside the count.
row.rival_reading: A household or work crew could keep a spare kit for an ordinary task; the missing name does not prove an emergency order.
row.gloss: A prepared pair is left without a clear account of why it was needed.
